/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRENSANOMBRE'
		Do 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRENSAMARCA'
		Do 'LoadPrensaMarcaOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_PRENSAMODELO'
		Do 'LoadPrensaModeloOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensasGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(WWPBaseObjects.LoadGridState.Udp(!"Produccion.listarPrensasGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"Produccion.listarPrensasGridState"))
	Endif	

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE"
				&TFPrensaNombre.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSANOMBRE_SEL"
				&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSAMARCA"
				&TFPrensaMarca.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSAMARCA_SEL"
				&TFPrensaMarca_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSAMODELO"
				&TFPrensaModelo.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFPRENSAMODELO_SEL"
				&TFPrensaModelo_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPrensaNombreOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPrensaNombre = &SearchTxt
	&TFPrensaNombre_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Prensa
		Order PrensaNombre
		using listarPrensasDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFPrensaMarca, &TFPrensaMarca_Sel, &TFPrensaModelo
					, &TFPrensaModelo_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each DB.Prensa
			Order PrensaNombre
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not PrensaNombre.IsEmpty()
			&Option = PrensaNombre
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPrensaMarcaOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPrensaMarca = &SearchTxt
	&TFPrensaMarca_Sel.SetEmpty()

		using listarPrensasDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFPrensaMarca, &TFPrensaMarca_Sel, &TFPrensaModelo
					, &TFPrensaModelo_Sel)

			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not PrensaMarca.IsEmpty()
			&Option = PrensaMarca
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadPrensaModeloOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFPrensaModelo = &SearchTxt
	&TFPrensaModelo_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each DB.Prensa
		Order PrensaModelo
		using listarPrensasDS(&FilterFullText, &TFPrensaNombre, &TFPrensaNombre_Sel, &TFPrensaMarca, &TFPrensaMarca_Sel, &TFPrensaModelo
					, &TFPrensaModelo_Sel)

		&count = 0
